model.title: Improve: 'Weir uses textiles. Satyamurti uses photographs.'

parts.text: Find the shared idea: objects that hold memory

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Weir's mother stitches memory into objects like the blazer, whereas Satyamurti's speaker fixes it in an image; both show grief needing something to hold.
